core_obligations: Computation (proof lines 9044-9065): the author uses the description of the lower shriek and the identification of stalks with stalks of the describing presheaf to write the stalk as a colimit of coproducts over the morphisms into the localizing object; assigning to each element of the colimit an element of the value of the point at that object decomposes the colimit as a coproduct over those elements of the corresponding colimits.
Identification (proof lines 9066-9068): the resulting expression is exactly the coproduct of the stalks at the constructed points.
proof_roadmap: Use the description of the lower shriek and reduce to a colimit of coproducts.
Decompose the colimit as a coproduct over the elements of the value of the point at the localizing object.
Identify the summands with the stalks at the constructed points.
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the stalk of the lower shriek of a sheaf along a localization as the coproduct of the stalks at the points associated with the elements of the value of the point at the localizing object (statement lines 9030-9042). The proof is a complete computation: the description of the lower shriek and the identification of stalks reduce the assertion to a colimit of coproducts over the morphisms into the localizing object (proof lines 9044-9059); assigning to each element of the colimit the corresponding element of the value of the point decomposes this colimit as a coproduct over those elements (proof lines 9060-9065); and the summands are identified with the stalks at the constructed points (proof lines 9066-9068). The non-formal content is the decomposition of the colimit. The claim is H2: a computation carried out in two steps with each input named.
